activation: Each defect is activated by name via the SAIQE_DEFECTS environment variable, read by TrainingDefectModel::loadActive().
freeze_rule: No defect may be added, removed or reworded after the first measurement run. Any change invalidates the run and requires a new register version.

classes.functional: Violates a documented functional requirement. No direct security consequence.
classes.security: Violates a security property. Carries a CWE and, where applicable, an OWASP LLM Top 10 identifier.
classes.accessibility: Violates an accessibility success criterion (WCAG 2.2 / EN 301 549).

defects.expected: A phone number must match the North American format before registration is accepted.
defects.injected: The format check is skipped; any non-empty string is accepted.

defects.expected: The justification narrative must be at least 50 characters.
defects.injected: Any non-empty narrative is accepted.

defects.expected: Household size must be within 1..20; the value feeds the poverty-threshold calculation.
defects.injected: The upper bound is removed, so an arbitrary value propagates into the eligibility decision.

defects.expected: Every control carries a <label for> bound to the control id.
defects.injected: Controls render with a placeholder only and have no accessible name.

defects.expected: Applicants under 18 fail the age hard-stop rule.
defects.injected: The minimum age drops to 17, admitting a class of ineligible applicants.

defects.expected: Income above 1.85x the poverty threshold is flagged for officer verification.
defects.injected: The multiplier becomes 2.85, so over-threshold incomes are never flagged.

defects.expected: An existing approved benefit for the same programme is a hard stop.
defects.injected: The rule never evaluates; duplicate benefits pass eligibility.

defects.expected: A citizen may hold at most 3 active applications.
defects.injected: The cap is not enforced.

defects.expected: A citizen token returns only that citizen's applications.
defects.injected: The ownership scope is dropped; every applicant's records are returned.

defects.expected: Role membership is decided by strict comparison.
defects.injected: Loose comparison admits numeric-string and leading-numeric role values.

defects.expected: A token whose HMAC does not match is rejected.
defects.injected: The comparison is skipped; any well-formed token is accepted with attacker-set claims.

defects.expected: Case status changes follow VALID_TRANSITIONS; an officer cannot reach Approved directly.
defects.injected: An officer can set a case straight to Approved, bypassing supervisor review.

defects.expected: A supervisor decision requires a recorded justification comment.
defects.injected: The comment requirement is skipped, breaking the decision audit trail.

defects.expected: SLA deadlines advance by business days, excluding Saturday and Sunday.
defects.injected: Calendar days are counted, so every deadline lands early.

defects.expected: A case past its deadline is marked breached.
defects.injected: An undocumented 48-hour grace window suppresses genuine breaches.

defects.expected: Upload admission is decided by the content-sniffed MIME type.
defects.injected: The filename extension decides admission, so a payload named invoice.pdf is stored.

defects.expected: Storage names are randomly generated and never derived from user input.
defects.injected: The client-supplied filename is reused, carrying traversal sequences into the storage path.

defects.expected: Uploads above 5 MB are rejected.
defects.injected: The size cap is not applied.

defects.expected: Notification bodies are HTML-escaped before display.
defects.injected: Stored markup reaches the browser intact (stored XSS).

defects.expected: A notification can only be mutated by its recipient.
defects.injected: The recipient predicate is dropped; any id can be mutated by any user.

defects.expected: The sort parameter is resolved against an allow-list; ORDER BY cannot be parameterised.
defects.injected: The raw parameter is concatenated into the statement.

defects.expected: The audit trail is append-only; deletion is refused with 405.
defects.injected: The refusal is lifted and records are destroyed.

defects.expected: State-changing requests must present a matching CSRF token.
defects.injected: Verification always succeeds.

defects.expected: The session identifier is regenerated at authentication.
defects.injected: The pre-authentication identifier survives, enabling session fixation.

defects.expected: A failed login records the attempt without the submitted secret.
defects.injected: The attempted password is written to the audit trail in clear text.

defects.expected: An account locks after MAX_FAILED_LOGINS consecutive failures.
defects.injected: The lock is never applied.

defects.expected: Bands are low <25, medium <50, high <75, critical >=75; high and critical require Quality Review.
defects.injected: Every boundary moves up ten points, so high-risk cases are graded medium and skip Quality Review.

defects.expected: The risk score is recomputed after a document upload changes the evidence set.
defects.injected: The score is left stale.

defects.expected: Applicant-supplied content is neutralised and fenced before entering the model context; it cannot change the recommendation.
defects.injected: Applicant content is passed verbatim and unfenced, so an instruction in an uploaded document steers the recommendation.

defects.expected: Generated text is escaped before reaching a template.
defects.injected: Generated text reaches the officer's browser as markup.

defects.expected: Every tool call is checked against the role registry and the case in scope.
defects.injected: The registry is not enforced; a tool call carried in from untrusted content executes with ambient authority.
